items: for a while, a little (see delimitative aspect) — по- + говори́ть (“to talk”) → поговори́ть (“to talk a bit, to chat”); по- + рабо́тать (“to work”) → порабо́тать (“to work a bit”)

(used with verbs) describing an action that lasts for a certain period of time — про- + ждать (“to wait”) → прожда́ть (“to wait (for a while, for some time)”); про- + рабо́тать (“to work”) → прорабо́тать (“to work (for a while, for some time)”)
